text: ポケモンの　カセキやら　しゃしんが　かざって　ある！

structure.jp: ポケモンの　カセキやら　しゃしんが

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある says someone did the action earlier and the result is still there to see. かざって　ある = 'have been put on display'.

patterns.name: 〜やら
patterns.span: カセキやら　しゃしん
patterns.explanation: やら between things gives a loose list, hinting there are more things like them. カセキやら　しゃしん = 'fossils, photos and the like'.
